items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, Kid Thomas is about the best one with the water glass around time. Does he use that? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he's good with it.

ctx.x: Dressed to kill, but he had a pair of sandals on. Yeah. Joe just didn't care. All he cared for was to play his music, see.
Well, Kid Thomas is about the best one with the water glass around time. Does he use that?
